title: Software Development Project Lead
description:
**Be a Part of the Technology Revolution**
There has never been a more exciting time to be part of an automotive technology company like Visteon. No industry offers more fast-paced change and opportunity than today’s automotive industry. We are in the midst of a mobility revolution that will completely change the way we interact with our vehicles, reduce the number of car accidents and fatalities, and make the world a cleaner place. Visteon is at the epicenter of this mobility revolution. Two major trends in the automotive industry – the shift to electric vehicles and vehicles with autonomous safety technologies – have created unique opportunities for Visteon. We are the only automotive provider solely focused exclusively on cockpit electronics – the fastest-growing segment in the industry.
  
  
**Key objectives of this Role:**

* Experience leading large design & architecture of automotive embedded products is preferred.
* Knowledgeable in different products (Cluster, Display, ADAS).
* Knowledgeable in large project management and delivery.
* Work independently and collaboratively with multiple teams.
* Communication with rationale and build consensus with stakeholders.
* Prioritize and manage work to critical project timelines in a fast-paced environment.
* Develop new approaches to complex design problems.
* High level of domain expertise.
* Lead overall project delivery and coordination across projects / multiple internal teams.
* Leverage project management skills and understanding of multiple domains/technology to balance projects with varying schedules and priorities.
* Sustain and lead efforts in High Level Design (HLD) through complete ownership and commitment to quality standards. Act as the single point of contact for all aspects relating to HLD.
* Understand and review business requirements with the software delivery team, leveraging their knowledge of multiple domains.
* Work on assigning the requirements between different tech teams internally, identifying the interfaces and dependencies. Work to ensure there is a clear channel of communication between teams to meet deliveries.
* Work with the architects to define project-specific architectures. Understand and contribute to the technical solution from design through to code level. Analyze technical issues and guide the teams to find solutions.
* Lead project-focused technical discussions between the domains and internal teams. Work with the integration and testing teams on triaging of defects with accurate assignment of defects and analysis of complex defects that would overlap multiple domains.
* Work with external vendors/suppliers on tools and other software. Support supplier quality and assessments with other internal teams.

**Key Performance Indicators:**

* On-Time Delivery: Achieve 85% or higher on-time delivery of customer milestones. Tracked on a sprint level.
* Code Coverage Metric: Percentage of Code Covered by Testing, Maintain code coverage at 85% or higher. Regularly monitored during each development cycle.
* Static Analysis KPI assessed at the end of each development iteration.
* Global Team Collaboration: Frequency and Effectiveness of Collaboration with Global Teams

**Qualifications, Experience, and Skills:**

* Bachelor’s or master’s degree or equivalent in Computer engineering, Electronics Communication Engineering or mechatronics or equivalent.
* 10+ years of software experience.

**Desired Competencies:**

* Detail Oriented: Capable of carrying out a given task with all details necessary to get the task done well.
* Dedicated: Devoted to a task or purpose with loyalty or integrity.
* Organized: Eye for detail and can put across ideas in a tangible form.
* Goal Completion: Inspired to perform well by the completion of tasks.
* Ability to Make an Impact: Inspired to perform well by the ability to contribute to the success of a project or the organization.

title: Support Engineer 2 (WMS/Warehouse Management )
description:
**Blue Yonder Title**
Support Engineer II
  
  
**Other Comparable Titles**
Product Specialist, Techno-Functional Architect
  
  
**Overview**
Join our leading AI-driven Global Supply Chain Solutions Software Product Company, recognized as one of the “Best Places to Work”. We are seeking a skilled Senior Support Engineer to enhance customer experience and provide robust solution support to Blue Yonder (BY) customers. The role demands an innovative, proactive approach to customer value creation and involves resolving complex technical issues with high expertise.
  
  
**Scope**

* Customer Solution Ownership: Achieve high customer satisfaction and positively impact NPS scores through end-to-end ownership, engagement, and proactive support.
* Global Team: Collaborate with 120+ global associates across the US, Mexico, India, Australia, and the UK, with rapid growth expected.

**Our Current Technical Environment**

* Software: BY Discrete, SQL, AppDynamics, Splunk, Oracle/MSQL, Java, GIT, Rest API, OAuth
* Cloud Architecture: MS Azure (ARM templates, AKS, Application gateway, Virtue Networks, Event Hub, Azure AD)
* Application Architecture: Scalable, resilient, event-driven, secure multi-tenant microservices architecture
* Frameworks/Others: Kubernetes, Kafka, Elasticsearch, Spark, NoSQL, RDBMS, Springboot, Gradle GIT, Ignite

**What You’ll Do**

* Support Engagements: Work with global technical and functional teams to support various customer engagements.
* Customer Interaction: Understand customer requests, support designed products/solutions to meet business requirements, and ensure high customer satisfaction.
* Issue Resolution: Address and resolve technical issues adhering to SLAs, document learnings, and create knowledge articles.
* Environment Management: Replicate and maintain customer environments and knowledge of customer solution architecture and integration points.
* Customer Satisfaction: Provide quality and timely solutions to improve customer satisfaction and follow-up until closure.
* Stakeholder Interaction: Interact with internal and external stakeholders and report to management.
* Process Improvement: Identify areas for improvement and automation in routine tasks.
* Continuous Learning: Stay updated with new technologies and products, demonstrate quick learning ability, and maintain good interpersonal and communication skills.
* Architecture Simplification: Drive simpler, more robust, and efficient architecture and designs.
* Product Representation: Confidently represent product and portfolio, including vision and technical roadmaps, within the company and to strategic customers when necessary.

**Detailed Responsibilities**

* Customer Issue Resolution: Understand customer-raised issues, especially in Cloud/SaaS environments, and take appropriate actions to resolve them.
* Code Review: Review product source code or design documents as necessary.
* Case Management: Own and resolve all cases for global customers, adhering to defined SLAs.
* Knowledge Sharing: Document learnings and create knowledge articles for repeated cases.
* Environment Replication: Replicate and maintain customer environments.
* Solution Knowledge: Maintain knowledge of customer solutions and customizations.
* Urgency in Interaction: Demonstrate a sense of urgency and swiftness in all customer interactions.
* Techno-Functional Point of Contact: Act as the techno-functional POC for all cases, ensuring timely triage and assignment.
* Global Collaboration: Utilize instant messenger and other tools to collaborate globally.
* Shift Work: Work in rotational shifts and be flexible with timings.
* Goal Achievement: Meet organizational and team-level goals.
* Customer Satisfaction: Improve customer satisfaction by providing quality and timely solutions and follow-up until case closure.
* Process Automation: Identify areas for improvement and scope for automation in routine tasks or activities.
* Team Player: Help in meeting team-level goals and be a team player.

**What We Are Looking For**

* Educational Background: Bachelor’s degree (STEM preferred) with a minimum of 5 to 7 years of experience.
* Team Experience: Experience in working as a team.
* Skills: Good communication and strong analytical skills.
* Technical Proficiency: Experience in working with SQL/Oracle DB complex queries.
* Domain Knowledge: Fair understanding of the Supply Chain domain.
* Support Engineering Experience: Experience in support engineering roles.
* Techno-Functional Expertise: Possess strong techno-functional expertise.
* Tech Savviness: Ability to adapt to any technology quickly.
* Critical Issue Support: Provide technical and solution support during critical/major issues.
* Tool Experience: Experience with varied tools such as AppDynamics, Splunk, and ServiceNow.
* Shift Flexibility: Flexible to work in shift timings:

+ Shift 1: 6 am to 3 pm
+ Shift 2: 2 pm to 11 pm
+ Shift 3: 10 pm to 7 am

By joining us, you will be part of a dynamic team committed to enhancing customer satisfaction through innovative solutions and continuous improvement in the supply chain industry.
  
  
**Our Values**
If you want to know the heart of a company, take a look at their values. Ours unite us. They are what drive our success – and the success of our customers. Does your heart beat like ours? Find out here: Core Values
  
  
All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability or protected veteran status.

title: Nexus Admin
description:

**Location: Bangalore, Chennai, Coimbatore**
**Shift Timing: Shift timings will be between 2pm - 11pm or 4pm-1 AM IST (Rotational Shift)**
**RTO: Hybrid (3 days Work from Office)**
Lead the end-to-end migration of artifact repositories from Nexus to Cloudsmith across the enterprise. Assess existing Nexus repositories, formats, dependencies, integrations, and usage patterns to develop migration strategies and execution plans. Design and implement repository structures, access controls, retention policies, and governance standards within Cloudsmith. Act as the primary administrator and SME for Nexus and Cloudsmith platforms. Plan and execute migration of Maven, NPM, NuGet, PyPI, Docker, Helm, and other package repositories to Cloudsmith. Develop automated migration, validation, and repository synchronization processes to ensure minimal business disruption. Integrate Cloudsmith with Jenkins, GitHub Actions, EKS, Docker, Snyk, and Git-based development workflows. Establish enterprise standards for artifact storage, package lifecycle management, version control, and repository governance. Configure authentication, authorization, RBAC, SSO, secrets management, and repository security controls. Enable software supply chain security practices through package scanning, artifact validation, and vulnerability management. Automate artifact publishing, repository management, and promotion workflows across development, testing, and production environments. Collaborate with development teams to onboard applications and migrate package publishing and consumption processes. Design and support Docker image repositories and container artifact management strategies. Integrate Cloudsmith repositories with Kubernetes and EKS deployment pipelines. Implement and maintain Snyk-based security scanning for artifacts, container images, and dependencies. Maintain and enhance repository platforms based on evolving business, operational, and compliance requirements. Monitor repository performance, storage utilization, availability, and platform health. Troubleshoot complex repository, package management, CI/CD, and integration issues and provide L3 support. Define backup, disaster recovery, archival, and retention strategies for enterprise repositories. Drive continuous improvement initiatives focused on automation, security, reliability, and developer experience. Create migration plans, technical documentation, operating procedures, architecture diagrams, and knowledge articles. Mentor engineering teams on Cloudsmith adoption, repository management best practices, and software supply chain security.

title: Kinaxis Lead Analyst
description:
Visteon is advancing mobility through innovative technology solutions that enable a software-defined future. Our state-of-the-art product portfolio merges digital cockpit innovations, advanced displays, AI-enhanced software solutions, and integrated EV architecture solutions. With expertise spanning passenger vehicles, commercial transportation, and two-wheelers, Visteon partners with global automakers to create safer, cleaner, and more connected journeys. Headquartered in Van Buren Township, Michigan, Visteon operates in 17 countries, employing a global network of innovation centers and manufacturing facilities. In 2024, we recorded annual sales of approximately $3.87 billion and secured $6.1 billion in new business.
  
  
Supports the growth and operations of the Kinaxis RapidResponse/Maestro platform within Global IT. Works alongside the Senior Kinaxis Consultant covering system configuration, integration support, testing, and day-to-day operations. Designed for a motivated professional with solid implementation experience ready to take on broader responsibilities
  
  

* Support end-to-end Kinaxis implementations — requirements, configuration, testing, and go-live.
* Build and maintain workbooks, dashboards, alerts, and data views.
* Assist in developing and maintaining data integration pipelines between Kinaxis and external systems (ERP, EDW).
* Monitor data loads and integration jobs; investigate and resolve data quality issues.
* Provide second-line technical support for Kinaxis issues raised by business users.
* Execute testing (unit, integration, UAT); document results and resolve defects.
* 5+ years hands-on Kinaxis Maestro; at least one full end-to-end implementation.
* BS/MS/PhD in Industrial Engineering, Supply Chain, Operations Research, Computer Science, Statistics or a related field.
* Practical experience building workbooks, dashboards, alerts, or data views.
* Working knowledge of data integration concepts and Kinaxis data feeds.
* Familiarity with SQL for troubleshooting and validation.
* Understanding of core supply chain planning concepts (demand, supply, inventory).
* Familiarity with ITIL concepts or service management practices (incident, change, problem).
* Kinaxis certification a plus; ERP exposure (SAP, QAD, IFS) and ETL experience welcome.

title: SAP Data-AD

Join EY and help to build a better working world.

Set the enterprise data strategy and roadmap, positioning SAP Business Data Cloud as the foundation for analytics and AI.
  
  
**Transformation Program Management:**
Lead complex SAP S/4HANA data migration and modernization programs at scale.
  
  
**Executive Advisory And Stakeholder Management:**
Advise C‑level leaders, shape strategic decisions, and demonstrate the business value of intelligent, data‑driven technologies.
  
  
**Data Governance And Quality:**
Establish enterprise‑wide data governance, including standards for data quality, stewardship, and master data management (MDG).
  
  
**Innovation And AI Adoption:**
Drive adoption of AI, machine learning, and advanced analytics solutions (e.g., SAP Joule, Predictive Analytics).
  
  
**Team Leadership & Mentorship:**
Lead and mentor global SAP teams, ensuring successful delivery across cross‑functional initiatives.
  
  
**Pre‑Sales & Business Development:**
Support business growth through solution design, proposal development, and client engagement.
  
  
**Required Qualifications And Experience**

* Experience: 20+ years in IT, including 10+ years in SAP Data & Analytics architecture and strategy with 5+ years in Leadership roles
* Data Technologies: Proficiency in SAP Datasphere, BODS, Information Steward, and data migration tools (e.g., Syniti, LTMC).
* Architectural Skills: Experience designing modern data platforms and integrating SAP with non‑SAP ecosystems (e.g., Snowflake, Databricks).

* Strategic Thinking: Ability to align data strategy with business objectives.
* Communication: Skilled at simplifying technical concepts for executive audiences.
* Problem‑Solving: Strong ability to resolve critical project risks and challenges.
* Data Modeling: Expertise in semantic modeling, CDS Views, and data lineage

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY is building a better working world by creating new value for clients, people, society and the planet, while building trust in capital markets.

title: Information Technology Support Specialist
description:

**IT Support & Application Development Engineer**
in
**Coimbatore**
.

**Coordinate with:**

* IT Manager / Hiring Manager to prioritize IT support and application development activities.
* Internal users and department heads to understand and resolve IT requirements.
* Software and hardware vendors for technical support, repairs, AMC, procurement, and warranty matters.
* Application users to gather requirements, test enhancements, and implement improvements.
* Cross-functional teams to develop solutions that improve business processes and operational efficiency.

**You have:**

* Strong hands-on knowledge of desktop, laptop, printer, and peripheral troubleshooting.
* Experience with Windows OS installation, configuration, and troubleshooting.
* Working knowledge of Microsoft 365 and common business applications.
* Basic knowledge of LAN, Wi-Fi, IP configuration, switches, routers, printers, and shared network resources.
* Working knowledge of at least one programming language or development stack such as
  **C#/.NET, Java, Python, PHP, or JavaScript**
  .
* Experience with web or desktop application development.
* Good understanding of SQL, including queries, joins, basic stored procedures, and reporting.
* Basic understanding of Git and software development lifecycle practices.
* Strong troubleshooting, analytical, and root-cause analysis skills.
* Good communication skills in English and Tamil.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities between IT support requests and application development activities.
* Ability to work independently and provide a service-oriented experience to internal users.
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Electronics, or a related discipline such as
  **B.E./B.Tech/B.Sc./BCA/MCA**
  .
* **3–4 years of relevant experience**
  covering IT support and application development.

* Have experience working in a manufacturing, engineering, electronics, or IT services environment.
* Have experience supporting ERP applications.
* Have experience with SQL Server or other relational databases.
* Have experience with IT ticketing/helpdesk systems.
* Have experience with network troubleshooting and endpoint security tools.
* Hold certifications such as
  **CompTIA A+, Microsoft, or networking certifications**
  .
* Have experience developing or supporting internal business applications.

**Why you'll love working with us:**

* Work with a global and multicultural engineering and technology team.
* Gain hands-on exposure to both IT infrastructure and business application development.
* Work directly with different functions to build practical technology solutions.
* Get exposure to manufacturing, ERP, database, and enterprise IT environments.
* Build your career across both IT support and application development.

title: Salesforce Automation QA
description:
**Core Requirements**

* **Technology:**

  Salesforce Automation QA(Playwright, Salesforce, Apex testing)
* **Experience:**
  3-5 years
* **Duration:**
  6 Months
* **Working Time:-**

  6:30 AM - 3:30 PM IST.

**Critical Deployment Notes**

* **Compliance:**
  For the background verification (BGV) process, PAN card and Aadhaar card of the proposed resources will be required.
* The
  **UAN number**

  is required for selected candidates.
  .

**JOB DESCRIPTION**

• Experience: 3–5 years of relevant experience in QA Automation, with strong exposure to

Salesforce testing.

• Strong hands-on experience in test automation, preferably within Salesforce-based

applications and enterprise web applications.

• Good understanding of Salesforce platform architecture, including Sales Cloud, Service Cloud,

Experience Cloud, Marketing Cloud, custom objects, workflows, flows, triggers, and

integrations.

• Strong hands-on experience with Playwright using JavaScript/TypeScript for UI automation.

• Experience with Selenium and familiarity with Salesforce-specific automation tools such as

Provar/Copado is desirable.

• Experience in mobile automation using Appium and WebdriverIO.

• Strong understanding of API testing and automation using REST/SOAP APIs.

• Experience configuring and executing automated tests through CI/CD pipelines, preferably

using GitHub Actions or similar DevOps tools.

• Exposure to performance testing using K6 and interpretation of performance test results.

• Exposure to AI-driven QA tools, AI-assisted test generation, test optimization, defect analysis,

or GenAI-based testing practices.

• Strong understanding of Agile/Scrum methodologies and modern QA practices.

• Excellent communication and client-handling skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively

with technical and business stakeholders.

• A strong learning mindset, adaptability, and enthusiasm to grow in AI, Salesforce, and

Automation Engineering.

**RESPONSIBILITIES**

• Develop, maintain, and execute automated test scripts using Playwright (JS/TS) for

Salesforce applications and integrations.

• Define and execute QA strategies, test plans, test scenarios, and automation approaches for

Salesforce implementations across Sales, Service, Experience, and Marketing Clouds.

• Design and maintain scalable test automation frameworks using Playwright, Selenium, and

other relevant automation tools.

• Develop and execute functional, regression, integration, UAT, API, and end-to-end testing.

• Validate Salesforce configurations, customizations, workflows, integrations, and business

processes.

• Perform Apex testing, including validation of triggers, classes, batch jobs, and associated

business logic.

• Write and execute SOQL/SOSL queries to validate Salesforce data and test results.

• Perform data validation using Salesforce Data Loader, Workbench, and other data

management tools.

• Develop automated tests for REST/SOAP APIs and validate data, responses, integrations, and

error scenarios.

• Configure and maintain test execution within CI/CD pipelines, ensuring automated

regression suites are integrated into deployment workflows.

• Perform mobile application automation using Appium/WebdriverIO where required.

• Conduct performance and load testing using K6, identify bottlenecks, and communicate

performance findings.

• Explore and implement AI-driven testing approaches, including AI-assisted test case

generation, test data generation, defect analysis, and automation optimization.

• Identify, document, prioritize, and track defects using Jira/Azure DevOps, ensuring timely

resolution and retesting.

• Maintain test cases and execution results using Jira, Xray, Zephyr, or equivalent test

management tools.

• Collaborate closely with Salesforce Developers, Administrators, Architects, Business

Analysts, and business users to understand requirements and ensure comprehensive test

coverage.

• Communicate effectively with client technical partners to clarify requirements, discuss

defects, and align on implementation and release expectations.

• Participate in Agile ceremonies including sprint planning, backlog refinement, daily stand-

ups, reviews, and retrospectives.

• Continuously identify opportunities to improve QA processes, automation coverage, test

efficiency, and release quality.

**PRIMARY SKILLS**

• Salesforce: Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Experience Cloud, Marketing Cloud, Custom Objects

• UI Automation: Playwright with JavaScript/TypeScript, Selenium

• Mobile Automation: Appium, WebdriverIO

• API Testing: REST/SOAP API testing and automation

• Salesforce Testing: Functional, Regression, Integration, UAT, End-to-End

• Salesforce Development Validation: Apex Triggers, Classes, Batch Jobs

• Salesforce Data Validation: SOQL, SOSL, Data Loader, Workbench

• CI/CD & DevOps: GitHub Actions or equivalent CI/CD platforms

• Performance Testing: K6

• Test Management: Jira, Xray, Zephyr

• Automation Framework: Framework design, maintenance, reusable test components, test data

management

• AI/GenAI: AI-assisted QA, test case/script generation, defect analysis, intelligent test automation

• Programming/Scripting: JavaScript/TypeScript; basic programming and scripting concepts

• Version Control: Git/GitHub

• Agile/Scrum: Sprint-based QA and DevOps practices

Secondary Skills(If Any)

• Experience with Salesforce DX (SFDX) and Salesforce CLI.

• Exposure to Provar, Copado or other Salesforce-specific testing/DevOps tools.

• Knowledge of Postman, Swagger/OpenAPI or equivalent API testing tools.

• Exposure to JMeter or other performance testing tools.

• Basic understanding of SOQL/SOSL optimization and Salesforce governor limits.

• Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or GCP.

• Exposure to Docker/containerized test execution.

• Knowledge of test reporting, dashboards, and QA metrics.

• Familiarity with Page Object Model, BDD, data-driven testing, and modular automation

frameworks.

• Exposure to AI/ML concepts, LLM-based tools, prompt engineering, or AI agents for software

testing.

• Experience working in client-facing or consulting environments.

**EDUCATIONAL QUALIFICATIONS**

• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related

discipline.

• Equivalent technical qualifications with relevant professional experience may also be considered.

Certifications Required(If Any)

• Salesforce Certified Administrator – preferred.

• Salesforce Platform Developer I – desirable.

• Salesforce Certified Platform App Builder – desirable.

• ISTQB Certified Tester / Test Automation Engineer – preferred.

• Relevant Playwright, Selenium, Appium, or AI/GenAI certifications are an added advantage.

• Certifications are preferred rather than mandatory, provided the candidate demonstrates

strong hands-on expertise

title: Workday HCM Technical Analyst
description:
Are you a Workday expert who enjoys solving complex business challenges, designing
  
  
innovative solutions, and making a real impact on the employee experience? We're
  
  
looking for a highly skilled
**Workday HCM Technical Analyst**
to serve as a key
  
  
technology partner to our Human Resources organization.
  
  
In this role, you'll be the go-to expert for Workday, driving the configuration,
  
  
optimization, integration, and continuous improvement of our HR technology ecosystem.
  
  
You'll work across multiple Workday modules, collaborate with business and technical
  
  
teams, and help transform HR processes through automation, analytics, and innovative
  
  
solutions. No two days are the same. One day you may be architecting a complex
  
  
integration, the next designing executive dashboards, implementing new functionality, or
  
  
solving business challenges through creative system configuration.
  
  
This is an exciting opportunity for someone who enjoys combining deep technical
  
  
expertise with strategic thinking. If you're passionate about Workday, thrive in a fast-
  
  
paced environment, and enjoy partnering with stakeholders to deliver meaningful
  
  
business outcomes, we'd love to hear from you.
  
  
**What You'll Love About This Role**

* Be a trusted Workday expert and technical advisor for HR.
* Influence the design and evolution of our HR technology landscape.
* Work with a broad range of Workday modules, integrations, security, reporting, and analytics.
* Interfaces and security will be your expertise area.
* Participate in challenging projects, enhancements, and new capabilities from concept through implementation.
* Partner with HR, IT, Payroll, Benefits, and vendors to deliver solutions that improve business processes and employee experience.
* Continuously learn and stay up to date on the latest Workday functionality, implementation trends and best practices.

**Core Capabilities**

* System Configuration: Experience deploying integrations for Workday HCM modules, including Core HCM, Recruiting, Talent Management, Compensation, and Benefits, to align with business requirements.
* Data Management: Manage data integrity and accuracy within the Workday system, including data imports, exports, and reporting. Conduct regular audits to ensure compliance with data standards.
* Integration Expert: Collaborate with IT and third-party vendors to design, implement, and maintain integrations between Workday and other systems (e.g., payroll, time tracking, IAM, and benefits administration).
* User Support: Provide technical support and training to HR staff and end-users, addressing system-related inquiries and troubleshooting issues as they arise.
* Reporting and Analytics Expert: Develop and maintain custom reports and dashboards in Workday to provide insights into HR metrics and support data-driven decision-making.
* Project Participation: Participate in Workday upgrade projects, enhancements, and new module implementations, ensuring timely delivery and adherence to best practices.
* Documentation: Create and maintain comprehensive documentation for system configurations, processes, and user guides to facilitate knowledge sharing and training.
* Compliance and Security: Ensure compliance with data privacy regulations and internal security policies, monitoring access and permissions within the Workday system.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in human resources, Information Technology, Business Administration, or a related field.
* 5+ years of experience as a Workday HCM Technical Analyst or in a similar role, with a strong understanding of Workday HCM modules, functionalities, interfaces, security, configurations and reporting.
* Proficiency in Workday reporting tools, including calculated fields, custom reports, and dashboards.
* Proficiency with Workday Integrations using XML, XSLT, SOAP, REST API, and Configurable Security/experience securing web services.
* Experience with Workday integrations (e.g., PICOF, PECI, WECI, EIB, Core Connectors, Workday Studio) is required.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to interpret data and provide actionable insights.
* Strong design and architecture skills to generate and maintain specification documents and integration documentation.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams.
* Detail-oriented with strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
* Workday HCM and Workday Integration certifications is a plus.

**Who We Are**
Mold-Masters (www.moldmasters.com) is a leading global supplier of hot runners, controllers, auxiliary injection and co-injection systems. We design, manufacture, distribute, sell and service highly engineered and customized plastic processing equipment that caters to every market. Mold-Masters is a business unit of Hillenbrand.
  
  
Hillenbrand (www.hillenbrand.com) is a global industrial company that provides highly engineered, mission-critical processing equipment and solutions to customers in over 100 countries around the world. Our portfolio is composed of leading industrial brands that serve large, attractive end markets, including durable plastics, food, and recycling. Guided by our Purpose — Shape What Matters For Tomorrow™ — we pursue excellence, collaboration, and innovation to consistently shape solutions that best serve our associates, customers, communities, and other stakeholders.
  
  
EEO: The policy of Hillenbrand Inc. is to extend opportunities to qualified applicants and employees on an equal basis regardless of an individual's age, race, color, sex, religion, national origin, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity/expression or veteran status. Additionally, Hillenbrand Inc. and our operating companies are committed to being an Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO) Employer and offers opportunities to all job seekers including individuals with disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation to assist with your job search or application for employment, email us at recruitingaccommodations@hillenbrand.com . In your email, please include a description of the specific accommodation you are requesting as well as the job title and requisition number of the position for which you are applying. At Hillenbrand, everyone is welcome to apply and "Shape What Matters for Tomorrow".

title: Electronics & Embedded Prototyping Engineer
description:
SurgeonsLab \| Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu, India \| On\-site \| Full\-time \| 0–7 years \| 2 openings
 



  





 Some of the world's leading medical\-technology companies use SurgeonsLab systems in their R\&D labs and in front of their customers. We design and build the electronics behind calibration rigs, test systems, and demonstration platforms. We are looking for engineers who can take a loosely defined requirement and turn it into a working, tested, documented prototype, quickly and without wasting money.
 



  





**ABOUT SURGEONSLAB:** 
 SurgeonsLab is an R\&D and manufacturing company. We design and build electronic, electromechanical, and fluidic systems for global medical\-technology companies. Our products are not regulated medical devices, but we build them to the quality standards our clients expect.
 



  





**WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE IN 12 MONTHS:** 
 You will have taken real systems from a written requirement through schematic, PCB, firmware, a validated prototype and translated into a product. Each will have a test protocol anyone on the team can run, and a clear record of what every iteration cost and what it taught us.
 



  





**WHAT YOU WILL OWN:** 




  





 \- Requirements to architecture: turn a client need into measurable specifications, block diagrams, component choices, and trade\-offs before design begins.
 



 \- Schematic and PCB design: 2–4 layer boards in KiCad, Altium, or similar, following IPC\-2221 and IPC\-7351 practice. Prepare Gerbers, BOMs, and assembly drawings, and work with PCB fabricators.
 



 \- Fast, smart sourcing: source components through DigiKey, Mouser, LCSC, element14, and local distributors. Check lifecycle, stock, lead time, landed cost into India, and second\-source alternates.
 



 \- Board bring\-up and firmware: bring up and debug boards, and write firmware in C/C\+\+ for STM32, ESP32, or similar (GPIO, ADC, PWM, UART, I2C, SPI, sensor, motor, and pump control, calibration routines).
 



 \- Test protocols: write repeatable protocols that state what is measured, with which instrument, against which limit, and how results are recorded.
 



 \- Cost\-aware iteration: plan each design spin around what it must prove, combine changes, prove fixes on the bench before re\-spinning, and track cost per iteration.
 



 \- Documentation: version\-controlled design files (Git), revision logs, test reports, and design\-for\-assembly feedback to the build team.
 



  





**MUST HAVE** 




 \- B.E./B.Tech or M.E./M.Tech in ECE, EEE, E\&I, Mechatronics, Embedded Systems, or a related field.
 



 \- At least one PCB you designed that was fabricated (academic, personal, or professional).
 



 \- Firmware you wrote that ran on real hardware, not simulation only.
 



 \- Hands\-on use of a multimeter, oscilloscope, bench power supply, and soldering station.
 



 \- Professional English: able to write clear test reports and speak with international engineering teams.
 



 \- Able to work on\-site in Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu. Candidates willing to relocate are welcome.
 



  





**PREFERRED** 




 \- Experience in product development, electronics manufacturing (EMS), robotics, instrumentation, lab equipment, or test and measurement.
 



 \- SMD soldering and hot\-air rework.
 



 \- Python for test automation or data logging.
 



 \- Working knowledge of IPC\-A\-610, IPC J\-STD\-001, ISO 9001, ESD control (ANSI/ESD S20\.20\), or safety and EMC concepts (IEC 61010\-1, IEC 61326\-1\).
 



 \- Awareness of how ISO 13485 medical\-device quality systems work, since our clients operate under them.
 



  





**CERTIFICATIONS (A PLUS, NOT MANDATORY)** 




 \- IPC CID (Certified Interconnect Designer)
 



 \- IPC J\-STD\-001 or IPC\-A\-610 (CIS/CIT)
 



 \- IPC\-7711/7721 rework and repair
 



 \- ESD control training (ANSI/ESD S20\.20 or IEC 61340\-5\-1\)
 



 \- ISO 9001 or ISO 13485 awareness or internal auditor
 



 \- Embedded or firmware certifications (ARM, STM32, or similar)
 



  





**LANGUAGES** 




 English is required. Tamil or other languages are welcome but not mandatory.
 



  





**WHY JOIN** 




 \- Work on the full product cycle, from idea to tested prototype, not one narrow slice.
 



 \- R\&D teams at global medical\-technology companies use your works.
 



 \- A clear growth path toward systems engineering or product ownership.
 



 \- Freshers get structured mentoring. Experienced engineers get real design authority.
 



  





 COMPENSATION
 



 ₹3\.6 – 10 LPA, based on experience and technical assessment.
 



  




* Our hiring process includes a hands\-on practical assessment.

 Avantor is looking for a Solution/Skills Architect (SA) is a strong technical/functional advisor who works closely with Skills Builder to define data analytics models, as well as the Decision Data Model in support of the skills workbench to enhance the Decision Intelligent skills catalog.
   

  

 The ideal candidate will have a strong background in SAP functional/technical configurations, BI reporting, and data integration, with the ability to collaborate across architecture, development, and customer\-facing teams. This role requires proficiency in
 **Prompt Engineering** 
 for AI\-assisted development, along with strong
 **API integration knowledge** 
 and database experience.
   

  

**Major Job Duties And Responsibilities**
* Translate business and functional requirements into technical specification documents.
* Architect skills with all features and functions, ensuring all are designed and developed per business requirements.
* Prepare skill blueprints and detailed documentation for each associated skill.
* Responsible for testing and overall QA of the solution from a functional standpoint.
* Collaborate with Decision Architect and Skill Builders to aid development and testing of Decision Data Models and applications.
* Run and support meetings and workshops with prospects and customers, ranging from early discovery sessions to detailed final presentations.
* Ensure operational controls are maintained and perform operating control self\-assessments as required.


**Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or equivalent experience.
* 5\+ years of AERA functional/technical or solutions architecture experience in a team\-based environment.
* 2\+ years of experience working in Agile/Scrum environments.


**Knowledge, Skills, And Abilities**
* Experience with developing Dashboards and Reports using different BI tools.
* Proficient with functional and technical configurations around SAP ECC 6\.0 or SCM 5\.x or 7\.x.
* Strong and hands\-on knowledge of key integration points between multiple systems such as SAP ECC, SAP APO, SAP BW, SAP IBP, HANA, Reporting, etc.
* Strong team player, capable of working collaboratively within and across internal and customer teams.
* Strong analytical, organizational, and communication skills.
* Proficiency in Prompt Engineering for AI\-assisted development workflows and automation.
* Strong API integration and consumption knowledge (RESTful/Web APIs) for solution design and connectivity.
* Ability to convert business needs into clear technical specifications and solution designs.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and work independently in a fast\-paced Agile delivery environment.
* Strong communication skills with business users, QA teams, developers, and customer\-facing teams.
* Strong documentation skills for skill blueprints, design specs, test results, and support procedures.
* Good understanding of software development lifecycle, change control procedures, and production support best practices.
* Experience working with distributed teams and cross\-functional stakeholders.
* Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a team environment.


**Added Advantage / Preferred Skills**
* Working knowledge of function modules, structures, tables, BAPIs, and BADIs.
* Knowledge of data science methods and tools.
* Knowledge and experience working with In\-Memory, MPP, column\-oriented, and relational database management systems.
* Experience using AI\-assisted development tools such as ChatGPT Codex and Claude Cowork.


**Disclaimer**
 The above statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by employees assigned to this classification. They are not intended to be construed as an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties and skills required of employees assigned to this position. Avantor is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.
   

  

**Why Avantor?**
**Dare to go further in your career.** 
 Join our global team of 14,000\+ associates whose passion for discovery and determination to overcome challenges relentlessly advances life\-changing science.
   

  

**The work we do changes people's lives for the better.** 
 It brings new patient treatments and therapies to market, giving a cancer survivor the chance to walk his daughter down the aisle. It enables medical devices that help a little boy hear his mom's voice for the first time. Outcomes such as these create unlimited opportunities for you to contribute your talents, learn new skills and grow your career at Avantor.
   

  

 We are committed to helping you on this journey through our diverse, equitable and inclusive culture which includes learning experiences to support your career growth and success. At Avantor, dare to go further and see how the impact of your contributions set science in motion to create a better world.

title: ATE RF Test Engineer – RF Semiconductor Validation & Test Development
description:
**ATE RF Test Engineer RF Semiconductor Validation \& Test Development** 




  




* Location: Coimbatore, Bengaluru, India
* Work Mode: Onsite
* Experience: 3 \-10 Years
* Employment Type: Full\-Time



  





 Role Overview
 



  





 We are seeking an ATE RF Test Engineer with experience in RF semiconductor validation, characterization, and automated test development. The role involves developing RF ATE test programs, supporting silicon bring\-up, optimizing production test solutions, and collaborating with cross\-functional engineering teams throughout the product lifecycle.
 



 The ideal candidate should have hands\-on experience with RF ATE platforms, RF measurements, production test development, and wireless communication technologies.
 



  





 Key Responsibilities
 


* Develop RF ATE test programs from scratch for Wafer Sort (WS) and Final Test (FT).
* Design, debug, and optimize RF functional, parametric, characterization, and production test solutions.
* Perform RF transmitter (TX) and receiver (RX) validation and characterization.
* Execute RF measurements including Output Power, Gain, EVM, ACPR, Harmonics, Spurious Emissions, Phase Noise, Frequency Error, Receiver Sensitivity, and BER.
* Develop RF calibration routines to improve measurement accuracy across ATE platforms.
* Analyze Wafer Sort and Final Test data to optimize yield, test limits, and test time.
* Develop and debug RF load boards, RF probe cards, calibration boards, and RF interface hardware.
* Perform ATE\-to\-bench correlation and validate RF measurement accuracy.
* Develop automation scripts for RF test execution, engineering analysis, and reporting.
* Support NPI, Engineering Validation (EV), Product Qualification, Characterization, Reliability, and Production Release activities.
* Work closely with RF Design, Product Engineering, Manufacturing, Reliability, Applications, Foundry, and Customer Engineering teams.
* Prepare technical documentation and contribute to continuous improvement of RF production test methodologies.



  





 Required Qualifications
 


* Bachelor's or Master's degree in:
* Electronics \& Communication Engineering (ECE)
* Electrical \& Electronics Engineering (EEE)
* Electronics \& Instrumentation Engineering (EIE)
* Instrumentation Engineering
* Computer Engineering
* Embedded Systems
* VLSI Design
* Microelectronics
* Semiconductor Technology
* Or a related engineering discipline
* 3 \-10 years of experience in RF semiconductor validation, characterization, or ATE RF test development.
* Experience supporting both engineering validation and production test environments.



 Technical Skills ATE Platforms
 


* Advantest V93000 RF
* Teradyne UltraFLEX RF
* Teradyne Magnum RF
* NI Semiconductor Test System (NI STS RF)



 RF Test Hardware
 


* Advantest Wave Scale RF (WSRF)
* Teradyne UltraWave
* Teradyne Flex RF Instrumentation
* NI PXI Vector Signal Transceiver (VST)
* NI PXI RF Signal Generator
* NI PXI RF Signal Analyzer
* RF Load Boards
* RF Probe Cards
* RF Calibration Boards
* RF Shielded Fixtures
* RF Switch Matrix



 RF Measurements
 


* Output Power
* Gain
* Error Vector Magnitude (EVM)
* ACPR
* Harmonics
* Spurious Emissions
* Noise Figure (NF)
* Receiver Sensitivity
* Blocking
* Intermodulation Distortion (IMD)
* Frequency Error
* Phase Noise
* Bit Error Rate (BER)



 RF Technologies
 


* Bluetooth
* Wi\-Fi
* GPS / GNSS
* NFC
* UWB
* Zigbee
* LoRa
* Cellular (4G/5G)



 RF Engineering
 


* RF Calibration
* S\-Parameters
* RF Signal Integrity
* Impedance Matching
* Silicon Characterization
* Production Test Optimization
* Yield Improvement
* ATE\-to\-Bench Correlation



 Programming \& Software
 


* Python
* C
* C\+\+
* Java
* VB
* SmarTest
* IG\-XL
* Eagle Vision

title: SAP BRIM CI FICA-Senior
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

**Career Family \- SAP Utilities / BRIM**
**The opportunity**
 As part of our EY GDS team, you will work to implement and support SAP FI\-CA/ Convergent Invoicing projects for clients. You will get an opportunity to work with high quality team. You will get an opportunity to build innovating product which solves client’s problem.
   

  

 We’re looking for Senior resources with expertise in SAP FI\-CA / FI\-CAX and SAP Billing and Revenue Innovation Management – Convergent Invoicing to join the EYD GDS team. This is a fantastic opportunity to be part of a leading firm whilst being instrumental in the growth.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
* To provide functional knowledge with hands\-on experience in electricity, gas and water utilities.
* Hands on experience configuring the IS\-U system
* Drive Business Workshops, Blueprint Sessions, develop BBPs/BBDs FS, Test Scenarios, conduct Trainings, perform Testing and provide defect management support for Device Management module
* Design core / customized business processes and provide best practices for ISU.
* Communicate complex requirements to and from Technical and Non\-technical stakeholders
* Willing to travel as per requirement
* Monitors the progress and the quality of the project


**Skills And Attributes For Success**
* Sound experience in SAP FI\-CA (Contract Accounting)
* Strong SAP FI\-CA, FICA – FI SD and FI MM integration knowledge
* Development experience in S/4 HANA, SAP ECC across all types of RICEFW objects
* Being familiar with SAP CRM/SOM/Hybris would also be very helpful
* Strong knowledge of SAP CI would be very helpful with minimum one end\-end BRIM CI implementation experience integration with SAP BRIM SOM, CC.
* SAP BRIM (CI) Functional Consultant in implementing SAP BRIM (CI) solution to support subscription business models.
* Must have strong knowledge of CI configuration and integration with SOM, CC, SD \& FI\-CA, FI/CO components of SAP solution.
* Additionally, must have extensive experience in implementing SAP FI\-CA, FI/CO solution.
* Must have completed multiple SAP projects and have excellent communication skills
* Confidence working within an offshore/onshore delivery model
* Proven expedience large stream of work across multiple locations
* Consulting experience advantageous
* Strong hands\-on experience on FI\-CA concepts:
+ Company Code Setup
+ Chart of Accounts and GL setup
+ Main / Sub Transaction Setup
+ Security Deposit Process
+ Incoming Payments (Real Time, Direct Debit, Cash Desk, etc.)
+ Outgoing Payments and Returns
+ Collection process using Collection Strategy
+ Collection Agency related process
+ Transfer Posting process
+ Escheatment process

* Strong knowledge of month\-end and period\-end closing and FICA to FICO GL integration.
* Implementation experience of BRF Plus.
* Experience and knowledge of using middleware technology to integrate SAP with third party systems for payments, collection agencies, etc.
* Experience in data migration.
* Can work under minimum supervision, good time management and work planning


**To qualify for the role, you must have**
* College degree in related technology field (Computer, Engineering, Science, etc.) or comparable job experiences
* Approximately 5 to 8 years of experience in a functional role. Able to exhibit a progression of increasingly complex job responsibilities during the period
* Prior SAP BRIM CI role is a must
* Should have worked on minimum 1 implementation from scratch as a lead consultant.


**Ideally, you’ll also have**
* Experience on integration with third\-party applications
* Knowledge of integration with SAP RAR, BRIM CI/SOM/CM
* Hands on experience in SAP S4 HANA Platform
* Experience on tools like JIRA or equivalent tool to maintain stories.
* SAP Utilities certifications are a plus:
+ Certification in SAP FICA (IUT240 / AC240 / BR240\)
+ Certifications in SAP BRIM Convergent Invoicing (AC245 / BR245\)


**Technologies and Tools**
* SAP FI\-CA / FI\-CAX
* SAP BRIM CI
* SAP FIORI
* Jira
* Azure DevOps


**What We Look For**
* A Team of people with commercial acumen, technical experience, and enthusiasm to learn new things in this fast\-moving environment
* An opportunity to be a part of market\-leading, multi\-disciplinary team in the integrated global transaction business worldwide.
* Opportunities to work with EY Utilities practices globally with leading businesses across a range of geographies


**What We Offer**
 EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is a dynamic and truly global delivery network. We work across six locations – Argentina, China, India, the Philippines, Poland and the UK – and with teams from all EY service lines, geographies and sectors, playing a vital role in the delivery of the EY growth strategy. From accountants to coders to advisory consultants, we offer a wide variety of fulfilling career opportunities that span all business disciplines. In GDS, you will collaborate with EY teams on exciting projects and work with well\-known brands from across the globe. We’ll introduce you to an ever\-expanding ecosystem of people, learning, skills and insights that will stay with you throughout your career.
   

  

* Continuous learning: You’ll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.
* Success as defined by you: We’ll provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way.
* Transformative leadership: We’ll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.
* Diverse and inclusive culture: You’ll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.


**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long\-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
   

  

 Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: FHIR Integration Architect
description:
**About the Role** 

  
 





 We're building an independent FHIR R4 interoperability layer that lets our CRM's clinical workflows starting with provider launch directly from inside the EHR, beginning with Oracle Health (Cerner) PowerChart. We need someone who can do both halves of this job well: design and personally validate the technical architecture, and lead the engineers full\-stack, AI, and QA who build it. This is not a design\-and\-handoff role. You'll be in the SMART on FHIR launch flow when it breaks, in the code review when a mapping rule is wrong, and in the room when the team needs a call made.
 

  
 




  





**What You'll Own** 

  
 




**Architecture \& Solution Design** 

  
 



* **Own** 

 the end\-to\-end architecture of the FHIR layer — SMART on FHIR launch and OAuth2, the canonical data model, the EMR adapter framework, tenant isolation, and event\-driven orchestration — and keep it extensible to future EMRs (Epic, athenahealth) and formats (HL7v2, X12\) beyond the Cerner pilot.
* **Make** 

 build\-vs\-buy and vendor decisions (self\-hosted HAPI FHIR vs. a managed FHIR store; Keycloak vs. a commercial identity provider; build vs. adopt an interface engine) and can defend the reasoning to both engineers and non\-technical stakeholders.
* **Design** 

 the architecture against HIPAA\-grade security and auditability requirements from day one — encryption, least\-privilege access, audit trails — not as a pre\-launch retrofit.
* **Validate** 

 the architecture against real constraints: Oracle Health/Cerner's actual FHIR R4 conformance, US Core and Da Vinci PAS implementation guides, and the operational realities of a live, EHR\-embedded launch — not just a reference diagram.



  





**Technical Leadership \& Delivery** 

  
 



* **Lead** 

 a cross\-functional engineering pod — full\-stack engineers, AI/ML engineers, and QA engineers — setting technical direction, running code and design reviews, and removing blockers day to day.
* **Translate** 

 the solution architecture into a sequenced, phased delivery plan (proof of concept → pilot → multi\-client scale) and hold the team accountable to it.
* **Own** 

 technical risk — surfacing integration blockers, vendor API gaps, and compliance findings early, and driving them to resolution rather than escalating and waiting.



  





**Integration, Standards \& Compliance** 

  
 



* **Lead** 

 the Cerner/Oracle Health integration end to end: SMART App Launch (EHR launch, OAuth2/OIDC, fhirUser claims), Ignite APIs registration, and coordination with the client health system's Cerner administrators.
* **Define and enforce** 

 conformance testing (ONC Inferno, US Core / Da Vinci PAS validation) before any integration is called production\-ready.
* **Partner with** 

 compliance and security stakeholders on HIPAA Security Risk Assessments, BAAs, and audit\-trail requirements.



  





**Required Qualifications** 

  
 



* 8\+ years in healthcare interoperability or integration engineering, including 3\+ years in an architect or technical lead capacity.
* Deep, hands\-on FHIR R4 experience — resource modeling, RESTful FHIR APIs, and at least one implementation guide (US Core at minimum).
* Direct experience implementing SMART App Launch (EHR and/or standalone launch), OAuth2/OIDC, and at least one major EHR's FHIR API — Cerner/Oracle Health experience specifically preferred given Phase 1 scope.
* Hands\-on experience with HAPI FHIR or an equivalent FHIR server — server customization and multi\-tenant partitioning are a strong plus.
* Cloud architecture experience on AWS or equivalent: containers, managed relational databases, event\-driven services (queues/event buses), and core identity/security services.
* Proven experience leading or managing engineers — running reviews, setting direction, and being accountable for a team's delivery, not only your own.
* Working knowledge of healthcare data exchange beyond FHIR — HL7v2, X12, CDA — sufficient to plan for future extensibility.
* Solid understanding of HIPAA technical safeguards and healthcare data compliance requirements.



  





**Strongly Preferred** 

  
 



* Direct, hands\-on experience with Oracle Health (Cerner) Millennium / Ignite APIs and PowerChart SMART app registration — or the Epic App Orchard equivalent.
* Experience with Keycloak or another open\-source identity provider, including custom extension/SPI development.
* Familiarity with Da Vinci implementation guides (PAS, CRD, DTR) and FHIR\-based prior authorization workflows.
* Experience in patient support programs, prior authorization, or healthcare CRM domains.
* Experience standing up a healthcare integration function from near\-zero on a small team, not only operating within an already\-mature enterprise integration group.
* Familiarity with applying AI/ML to healthcare data mapping, document generation, or clinical NLP — relevant given the AI engineers on this team.



  





**Tech Stack You'll Work With** 

  
 




**Layer** 

  
 




**Technologies** 

  
 




**FHIR \& integration standards** 

  
 





 FHIR R4, SMART App Launch v2, US Core, Da Vinci PAS, OAuth2 / OIDC, HL7v2 (future\-facing) 
 




**FHIR server** 

  
 





 HAPI FHIR (JPA server), multi\-tenant partitioning 
 




**Identity** 

  
 





 Keycloak, custom SMART\-launch extension (SPI) 
 




**Cloud / infra** 

  
 





 AWS — Fargate/ECS, Aurora PostgreSQL, DynamoDB, API Gateway, WAF, EventBridge/SQS, Secrets Manager, KMS, CloudWatch/OpenSearch 
 




**IaC / delivery** 

  
 





 Terraform or AWS CDK, CI/CD (GitHub Actions or CodePipeline), Docker 
 




**Target EHR (Phase 1\)** 

  
 





 Oracle Health / Cerner Millennium (Ignite APIs, PowerChart chart\-toolbar launch) 
 




**Conformance testing** 

  
 





 ONC Inferno test kit (incl. Da Vinci PAS), Synthea synthetic data

title: AI Integration Engineer
description:
**Company Description** 




**NXGEN** 
 is a Switzerland\-based technology company redefining how the security industry operates. Our platform brings video surveillance, alarms, AI, and IoT sensors into one unified system used by monitoring centers around the world.
 



 We’re not just building software; we’re transforming an industry. Our technology enables operators to manage thousands of sites, automate workflows with AI, and dramatically increase operational efficiency without increasing headcount.
 



 At
 **NXGEN** 
 , we believe great technology is built by great teams. We foster a culture of performance, innovation, and ownership where people are encouraged to think boldly, move fast, and continuously improve.
 



 As
 **NXGEN** 
 continues to grow and expand, we are looking for a talented
 **AI Integration Engineer** 
 to join our team and help build the next generation of our device integration platform.
 



  





**Role Description** 




 The AI Integration Engineer will design, build, and continuously improve an
 **AI\-driven engineering pipeline** 
 that enables NXGEN to rapidly integrate edge devices, cameras, NVRs, access\-control systems, alarm panels, IoT devices, and other physical\-security technologies into our platform.
 



 The role combines
 **AI agent development, software engineering, device/API integration, automation, CI/CD, and testing** 
 to create a highly automated
 **Device Integration Factory** 
 .
 



 The long\-term goal is to transform traditional manual integrations into an agentic workflow where AI agents can analyze vendor documentation, generate integration code, build and deploy integrations in isolated environments, run automated tests, identify and fix failures, and prepare validated changes for engineering review.
 



 The engineer will own the architecture, implementation, and continuous improvement of this platform while keeping human engineers as the final approval authority for production changes.
 



  





**Responsibilities:** 



* Design and build an AI\-powered
 **Device Integration Factory** 
 capable of automating the integration of new vendors and devices
* Develop structured workflows using AI coding agents such as
 **Claude Code, OpenAI Codex/ChatGPT** 
 , LLM APIs, and agent frameworks
* Build AI agents capable of analyzing vendor documentation, SDKs, APIs, protocols, and sample code and converting them into actionable integration plans
* Develop reusable integration templates for REST APIs, WebSockets, TCP, MQTT, HTTP webhooks, RTSP, ONVIF, SIA, SDK\-based integrations, Node\-RED, and event\-driven architectures
* Build AI\-assisted capability mapping between vendor\-specific functionality and NXGEN’s standard platform capabilities
* Create automated, isolated
 **sandbox environments** 
 for safely building and testing AI\-generated integrations
* Develop automated testing frameworks covering connectivity, authentication, device management, events, alarms, video, controls, reliability, and failure recovery
* Enable AI\-driven test\-case generation based on API specifications, device documentation, requirements, and existing integration patterns
* Integrate the AI development workflow with Git, CI/CD, Docker, artifact repositories, automated testing, code quality checks, and security scanning
* Build mechanisms that allow AI agents to create branches, generate and modify code, run builds and tests, troubleshoot failures, and prepare pull requests for engineering review
* Build and maintain an integration knowledge base containing vendor APIs, device capabilities, protocols, previous implementations, test cases, known issues, and lessons learned
* Develop an Integration Planning Agent capable of automatically generating implementation plans for new devices and vendors
* Perform device and protocol analysis when documentation is incomplete, including analysis of SDKs, network traffic, HTTP/WebSocket communication, TCP, MQTT, RTSP, and device logs
* Implement human\-in\-the\-loop controls that identify situations requiring engineering intervention and generate clear escalation packages with evidence and recommendations
* Build observability for the AI integration pipeline, tracking execution time, iterations, failures, human interventions, test pass rates, code acceptance, integration reuse, and AI/API consumption
* Ensure AI\-generated code follows security, compliance, and engineering standards, including secure credential handling, sandboxing, dependency scanning, SAST, container scanning, and auditability
* Automate the generation of integration documentation, API mappings, capability matrices, test plans, test reports, troubleshooting guides, and release notes
* Continuously analyze completed integrations and improve reusable patterns, templates, agents, and automation to make every future integration faster and more reliable



  





**Qualifications:**

 **LLM\-based coding agents and AI automation**

title: L2 Support Engineer - Managed Services
description:
Role Summary
   

  

 The Level 2 Managed Service Engineer for the End\-to\-End Observability team is responsible for advanced troubleshooting, root cause analysis, Datadog configuration, incident escalation, and continual service improvement across the observability stack. This role serves as the primary escalation point for L1 engineers and is expected to independently resolve, or drive resolution of, moderately complex incidents spanning application, infrastructure, network, APM, Synthetics, logs, and RUM data across both 3\-tier and cloud\-native environments.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Act as the first escalation point for incidents triaged by L1 engineers that require deeper investigation.
* Perform root cause analysis (RCA) by correlating APM traces, infrastructure metrics, network telemetry, logs, Synthetics results, and RUM data.
* Configure and fine\-tune advanced Datadog capabilities: custom metrics, log pipelines, monitors with composite/anomaly detection, SLOs, and dashboards aligned to service ownership.
* Guide and review Datadog APM instrumentation coverage across services; identify monitoring gaps and recommend improvements.
* Independently identify whether an issue originates in the application tier, infrastructure, network, or a third\-party dependency, in both 3\-tier and cloud\-native (microservices/containerized) environments.
* Lead or actively participate in major incident bridge calls, providing observability data to speed up resolution.
* Own problem management: identify recurring incidents, drive permanent fixes, and track them to closure.
* Mentor and coach L1 engineers on triage techniques, Datadog usage, and escalation quality.
* Contribute to automation of routine monitoring tasks (alert enrichment, auto\-remediation triggers, ticket auto\-creation).
* Support capacity and performance trend analysis using historical Datadog data.
* Review and refine monitors to reduce noise and false positives (alert tuning).
* Ensure adherence to SLAs/OLAs and maintain quality of incident documentation and RCA reports.
* Participate in client/stakeholder calls to explain incidents, trends, and improvement plans.


**Required Skills And Experience**
 Observability Platform Skills
   

  

* 3 to 6 years of experience in Managed Services, NOC, SRE, or application/infrastructure support roles, with at least 1\-2 years working hands\-on with Datadog.
* Strong working knowledge of Datadog across monitoring, dashboards, alerting, APM, Synthetics, RUM, logs, metrics, SLOs, and service\-level troubleshooting.
* Advanced monitor configuration (anomaly detection, forecast, composite monitors, SLOs).
* APM: distributed tracing, service maps, trace analytics, and identifying instrumentation gaps.
* Synthetics: designing multi\-step API and browser tests, analyzing failure trends.
* RUM: correlating front\-end performance and errors with backend traces.
* Log Management: building log pipelines, parsing rules, and log\-based metrics.
* Solid understanding of infrastructure concepts: compute, storage, containers, orchestration (Kubernetes basics), and cloud resource scaling.
* Solid understanding of networking fundamentals: DNS, load balancing, latency/packet loss analysis, firewall and connectivity troubleshooting.
* Strong analytical ability to read application logs, stack traces, and error patterns to isolate the failing component, without needing to be an expert in the underlying code.
* Experience with ITSM tools for incident, problem, and change management.
* Working knowledge of ITIL processes, especially incident and problem management.


 Application and Architecture Understanding
   

  

* Solid understanding of 3\-tier application architecture and how load, latency, or failure at one tier cascades to others.
* Solid understanding of cloud\-native architecture: microservices, containers, API gateways, service meshes, and inter\-service communication patterns.
* Ability to correlate application\-level symptoms (errors, latency, timeouts) with underlying infrastructure or network causes using observability data alone.
* Understanding of common resiliency patterns (retries, circuit breakers, caching, load balancing) and how their failure shows up in monitoring data.


 Good to Have
   

  

* Datadog certification (APM, Infrastructure, or Log Management specialization).
* Scripting experience (Python, Shell, PowerShell) for automation and custom integrations.
* Exposure to Infrastructure as Code (Terraform) for managing Datadog configuration as code.
* Experience with CI/CD pipelines and how deployments correlate with monitoring anomalies.
* Exposure to other observability or APM tools (New Relic, Dynatrace, Splunk, Grafana, Prometheus).


 Soft Skills
   

  

* Strong ownership and accountability for incident resolution.
* Ability to communicate technical findings clearly to both technical teams and stakeholders.
* Mentoring ability and patience when guiding L1 engineers.
* Comfortable leading discussions during high\-pressure major incidents.
* Structured approach to documentation and knowledge sharing.


 Education
   

  

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Electronics, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience).


 Work Details
   

  

* Level: L2 (Mid\-level, Managed Services)
* Shift: 24x7 rotational shifts, with on\-call/escalation coverage as needed
* Reporting To: L3 Engineer / Observability Team Lead


 Interested can reach us at \+91 7305206696/ saranyadevib@talentien.com

 Large Language Models (LLMs)

 Microsoft Azure Data Services

 15 years full time education
   

  

**Role Summary / Description**
 AI Powered Tech Talent
   

  

 Engineer role in AI LLM Technology Architecture. Hands\-on engineering role focused on designing, building, integrating, testing and operationalizing enterprise\-grade LLM, GenAI and agentic AI components across active client engagements.
   

  

 Own platform\-specific engineering on Azure, translating high\-level architecture into working, production\-quality components for LLM\-driven applications, RAG pipelines, multi\-agent workflows and AI platform integrations.
   

  

 Bring practical industry experience in banking, insurance, healthcare, public sector, retail or energy to identify domain data, process constraints, controls and adoption risks while designing GenAI solutions that are safe, scalable and relevant.
   

  

 Operate as a hands\-on technical lead or engineering lead, contributing code, design decisions, reusable patterns and engineering documentation.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

 Design and build LLM application components including prompts, tools, agents, orchestration flows, memory/context handling, retrieval pipelines and evaluation harnesses.
   

  

 Create Foundry\-based agents with enterprise tools, knowledge and memory integrate Azure AI Search for RAG implement secure API/tool calls through API Management, Logic Apps and Functions instrument traces, evaluations, guardrails and policy controls for production agents.
   

  

 Implement data ingestion, parsing, chunking, enrichment, embeddings, vector search and retrieval workflows for structured and unstructured enterprise content.
   

  

 Engineer safety and control components including PII detection/redaction, prompt\-injection defenses, content filters, guardrails, authentication, authorization, lineage and audit logging.
   

  

 Collaborate with architects, data engineers, product owners and security stakeholders to convert solution designs into tested, observable and maintainable software components.
   

  

 Maintain technical artifacts such as component designs, integration specifications, deployment runbooks, evaluation results and reusable engineering patterns.
   

  

**Required Qualifications**
 Bachelor s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Data Science, AI/ML, Information Technology or a related engineering discipline.
   

  

 Hands\-on coding experience in Python and strong understanding of APIs, distributed systems, CI/CD, testing, observability and secure SDLC practices.
   

  

 Experience delivering AI/ML or data products in at least one industry domain such as banking, insurance, healthcare, public sector, retail or energy.
   

  

**Required Skills/ Experience**
 Hands\-on experience with Microsoft Foundry / Azure AI Foundry, Foundry Agent Service, Azure OpenAI models, Azure AI Search, Prompt Flow, Azure Functions, Logic Apps, API Management, Event Grid, Microsoft Fabric, Entra ID, Key Vault, Azure Monitor and Application Insights.
   

  

 Strong understanding of LLM application architecture patterns including RAG, function/tool calling, agent orchestration, model invocation, prompt engineering, embeddings, vector databases and evaluation metrics.
   

  

 Ability to implement traditional ML and GenAI components across ingestion, feature/data preparation, model integration, deployment, monitoring and continuous improvement.
   

  

 Practical knowledge of security, privacy, governance, performance, scalability, reliability and cost controls for production AI systems.
   

  

 Experience with Git\-based development, automated testing, CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure\-as\-code and agile delivery in client\-facing environments.
   

  

 Good to Have Skills
   

  

 Azure AI Engineer, Azure Solutions Architect or Azure Developer certification experience with Microsoft Fabric, Semantic Kernel, Prompt Flow, private networking, Defender for Cloud and enterprise Responsible AI governance.
   

  

 Exposure to open\-source frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, Haystack, MLflow, FastAPI, Docker and Kubernetes.
   

  

 Experience with Responsible AI, model risk management, synthetic data generation, human\-in\-the\-loop review, A/B testing and GenAI cost optimization.

 TechGuard Labs Foundation is a joint Israel–India cybersecurity center established in 2026 in Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu, by leading academic and industry partners including SNR Sons Trust, Ariel University, ERA IT Consulting \& Audit Ltd, and Promitei Ltd. The center combines proven Israeli cybersecurity methodologies and assessment techniques with deep Indian expertise to strengthen cyber resilience for enterprise, institutional, and public sector organizations. TechGuard operates across the full cybersecurity lifecycle, including risk and readiness assessment, governance, continuous monitoring, incident response, and recovery. Anchored in India and supported by international partners, the organization is committed to adapting to evolving regulatory, threat, and technology environments. TechGuard values excellence in strategy, compliance, technology, and talent to deliver robust cyber\-resilience solutions.
 



**Role Description** 
 The System Integration Consultant is a full\-time, on\-site role based in the Greater Coimbatore Area. This role is responsible for assessing client business processes and technical environments, designing integration architectures, and implementing secure, scalable connections between cybersecurity platforms, enterprise applications, and infrastructure components. The consultant collaborates with cross\-functional teams to gather requirements, map data flows, configure interfaces, and validate end\-to\-end system performance. Day\-to\-day activities include conducting technical and functional analyses, preparing integration and migration plans, coordinating implementation timelines, and supporting testing, documentation, and knowledge transfer. The consultant also provides ongoing advisory support to clients, helping them optimize integrated solutions for resilience, compliance, and operational efficiency.

* Strong analytical skills to evaluate complex systems, data flows, and cybersecurity requirements.

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field; relevant certifications in integration, cybersecurity, or project management are a plus.
* Effective communication and documentation skills, with the ability to work collaboratively in multidisciplinary teams and with external partners.
* Willingness to work on\-site
